scriptsInfo.build: Production release: .app bundle (helper + Swift + Resources). Use build:dmg for DMG.
scriptsInfo.build:dmg: Same as build but also creates signed dist/Joker of Time.dmg.
scriptsInfo.release: Signed, notarized DMG. Uses notary profile AC_PASSWORD_KEY (run 'xcrun notarytool store-credentials AC_PASSWORD_KEY' once).
scriptsInfo.start: Dev with watch: build helper, mock KOT server, Swift app. App language follows OS.
scriptsInfo.timecard: Set mock timecard state. Usage: yarn run timecard <state> (e.g. not-working | working-not-clocked-in | clocked-in | clocked-out)
scriptsInfo.clear-credentials: Clear dev credentials (UserDefaults); restart app to see credentials form
scriptsInfo.clear-production-data: Clear all production app user data (Keychain + UserDefaults for dist .app)
scriptsInfo.extract-symbols: Export menu bar SF Symbols to black SVGs in docs/icons (requires pdf2svg: brew install pdf2svg)
